extracted.intended_audience: readers and students of American short fiction; anthology buyers and library patrons
extracted.subtask_short: anthology selection for American short stories
extracted.subtask_description: Curating or assessing a 'best of the century' anthology of American short stories — choosing works that represent a century's accomplishments and enduring value. The page is a bibliographic/description record for such an anthology and implies selection criteria used by the editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Endurance / enduring the test of time
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories that have endured the test of time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The anthology assembles stories that continue to speak to readers beyond their original publication era — works selected because they have lasting relevance and durability across decades.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representing a century's unsurpassed accomplishments
rubrics_metrics.description: Represents a century's worth of unsurpassed accomplishments in this quintessentially American literary genre.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection emphasizes 'masterworks' — stories seen as exemplary achievements in craft and significance across the 20th century (examples cited include Hemingway, Faulkner, O'Connor, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Shaping and defining the landscape of the American short story
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers who have shaped and defined the landscape of the American short story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included works are those by authors judged to have influenced the form, themes, and direction of American short fiction; editor's choices highlight canonical influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unflinching exploration of the human condition
rubrics_metrics.description: Stories that have unflinchingly explored all aspects of the human condition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for works that confront difficult, complex, or universal human experiences with depth and honesty; thematic courage and psychological insight are valued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Historical/temporal representativeness (1915–1998 selection)
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles selected by John Updike from the 1915 through 1998 editions of The Best American Short Stories series.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection criterion includes coverage across the 20th century via prior annual editions, implying attention to historical breadth and continuity over time rather than a single-year snapshot.
